findings.evidence: The declarations at lines 53–220 delegate directly to replacements in `UniversalEnveloping/Kostant/MinusculeWeightTable.lean`, respectively at lines 65–250; for example line 54 is exactly `weightTable.raisingMatrixQ i` and line 213 is exactly `weightTable.rep_serreKostantForm_mem_lattice hu hv`.
findings.fix: Delete these compatibility wrappers and update in-repository consumers to use `weightTable.raisingMatrixQ`, `weightTable.rationalSerreRepresentation`, `weightTable.rep`, and the corresponding `weightTable.*` theorems directly.
findings.issue: Twenty E₆ declarations are now thin aliases of the canonical `MinusculeWeightTable` API: `raisingMatrixQ`, `loweringMatrixQ`, `cartanGeneratorMatrixQ`, their apply lemmas, `isSerreSystemQ`, `rationalSerreRepresentation` and generator lemmas, `rep`, `rep_ι_apply`, both square lemmas, both represented-root lemmas, `rep_serreRootGenerator_mem_lattice`, `isCartanWeightVector_single`, and both Kostant-form stability lemmas.

summary: The generic table API is useful, but the migration retains the entire obsolete E₆ surface as compatibility-only wrappers.
